opening.argument: The presentation ties a supplied cryptocurrency-exchange referral link to eligibility for a bonus of up to $170, making the reward the stated reason to complete the signup process. It then moves viewers through account registration, identity verification, depositing money, and a card-funded USDT purchase, including the instruction that they must enter card information. This connects a low-barrier promotional offer with financial-account setup and requested payment details. The records do not establish that the bonus was paid, that the destination was authentic, or that any viewer suffered a loss. The alternate exchange names in the narration may also reflect transcription error.
